## Site URL

The URL of the website where the extension does not work correctly.

## Describe the issue

- [ ] Field detection fails (fields not detected)
- [ ] Field classification is wrong (wrong intent / low confidence)
- [ ] Autofill mapping is incorrect (wrong value proposed)
- [ ] Fill execution fails (fields not filled)
- [ ] UI issues (overlapping, styling, popup)
- [ ] Other

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to site URL
2. Click "Detect Form Fields"
3. Observe behavior

## Expected behavior

What should happen instead?

## Site details

- Site type: [e.g. job application portal, career site, ATS]
- Login required: [Yes / No]
- If login required, is the form behind authentication: [Yes / No]
- Form type: [e.g. single page, multi-step, modal, iframe]

## Extension version

- Extension version: [e.g. v0.2.0]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 125, Edge 124]

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots of the form and the extension popup.
